replyLocked: Replies use the mailbox where this conversation belongs.
senderUnavailable: This mailbox is unavailable for sending. Create a copy in an active mailbox to continue.
mailboxesError: Your mailboxes could not be loaded.
copyDescription: Create a separate draft in the selected mailbox. Your message, recipients and attachments stay in place, and the original draft remains in its mailbox.
copyError: The new copy could not be saved. Your original draft and current edits are preserved.
saveError: Your draft could not be saved. Please try again before sending.
partialDescription: The sending server accepted the message for some recipients and refused others. Checking status will not send another copy.
unknownDescription: The server acknowledgment was not received. The message may already have been sent. Check its status before creating another message.
acceptedReviewDescription: The sending server accepted your message. Its CRM copy still needs to be saved. Checking status repairs the copy without sending again.
pendingDescription: This send is already being processed. Check its status to see the result; it will keep the same send request.
rejectedDescription: The sending server did not accept this message. Retrying uses the same saved request. Your draft remains available.
sentCopyFailed: Your CRM copy is saved. The additional copy could not be saved to the selected Sent folder. The message will not be sent again.
sentCopyUnknown: Your CRM copy is saved. The additional Sent-folder copy could not be confirmed. It will not be repeated automatically.
draftLoadingError: This draft could not be loaded. Try again to keep its original mailbox and content.
draftMissing: This draft is no longer available.
connectFailed: Your Gmail mailbox was not connected.
connectFreshAuth: Verify your identity again, then reconnect your Gmail mailbox.
connectPermission: You do not have permission to connect this mailbox.
connectCancelled: Gmail connection was cancelled. Your existing mailboxes are unchanged.
alreadySentDescription: The sending server accepted this message and its CRM copy is saved. It will not be sent again.
scheduledDescription: This message already has a scheduled send request. Checking status keeps that request and does not create another one.
statusError: The send status could not be checked. Your saved request is preserved. Try again.
editDescription: First cancel the previous unsubmitted request, then keep this draft and create a new send request for your corrections.
editBlocked: The previous request could not be cancelled safely. Keep this draft and check its status.
connectExpired: The connection session expired. Start the Gmail connection again.
connectRevocation: The previous connection is still being revoked. Reconnect after that has finished.
